sinopsis.es: La asombrosa historia del Lorraine Motel de Memphis, Tennessee, donde asesinaron al reverendo Martin Luther King Jr., y de sus extraordinarios dueños, Walter y Loree Bailey.
sinopsis.en: Renowned documentarian Sam Pollard tells the astonishing, inspiring story of the Lorraine Motel in Memphis, Tennessee, site of the assassination of Reverend Martin Luther King, Jr., and its remarkable owners, Walter and Loree Bailey.
